critique: The note proves exact rational endpoint computation for a fully expanded, positive-rational, at-most-two-child quasi-Markovian class under supplied scalar width, together with a separate binary few-relevant-block algorithm; these are genuine but representation-sensitive computational results. The language of independently replayable or skeptical certificates exceeds the delivered artifact: Verify and Gen are abstract mathematical algorithms, while the serialized parser, executable checker, corruption tests, and refinement proof remain open in executable-refinement. The only worked evidence is a fixed fixture whose supplied width is 71, for which the stated exponential bound is enormous, so the package does not demonstrate practical usefulness on realistic graph-to-bound instances. These limitations keep the leading-journal score near the computational-design anchor despite the field-level theorem contribution.
